visual_inspection.observations: Both actual CPU backends: textured market with player/guards; bank counter/bankers/rope posts and inventory restocked to22 lobsters; return route at2649,3284 with building geometry occluding player. Scene2 status, one running bot, minimap and script overlays visible. Existing chat/overlay text overlap visible on both. No obvious candidate blank/corrupt geometry. Different stochastic NPC/player positions mean this is not pixel equivalence.
visual_inspection.scope: N1 focused CPU gameplay capture proof only; no scene1 freeze, focus/detach or lifecycle acceptance
